encounters.summary: Met Atte during the first day's travels; joined him and Thundrus in the hunt for Hogger in Elwynn Forest.
Quested with Atte, Quillb and Civa in the Wetlands in preparation for the next day's Stockades.
Met Atte at the start of the journey, hunted Hogger with Spagetoll, and received equipment crafted by Atte.
Reunited with Atte and Quillb in Redridge Mountains, where they also met Civa.

Fought shoulder to shoulder with Atte against Big Will during The Affray on Fray Island, earned warrior training and followed the mysterious notes from Westfall through the Barrens to Stonetalon Mountains.
Joined Atte's first fellowship, shared time in Goldshire, and departed before the Hogger hunt.
Reunited with Atte and Thundrus in Redridge Mountains, alongside Civa.
Quested with Atte, Civa and Spagetoll in the Wetlands in preparation for the next day's Stockades.
Travelled with Atte to Ironforge and completed the Hall of Thanes twice.
Fought through the Deadmines with Atte, defeated Edwin VanCleef twice, and adventured in Redridge and Duskwood.
Completed Duskwood quests with Atte, separately from Lilbigmenace.
Cleared the Stockade, Shadowfang Keep, Excavation Site: Wetlands, Wailing Caverns and Gnomeregan with Atte and Melan Holya, defeating every boss together.
Met Atte in Redridge Mountains with the hunter pet Milfhunter, and joined him for fishing at Lake Everstill.
Completed Duskwood quests with Atte, separately from Furrassic.
First met Atte with Quillb and Thundrus during a gathering in Redridge Mountains.
Met Atte outside Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands for gear crafting and a friendly duel, won by Atte.
Quested with Atte, Quillb and Spagetoll in the Wetlands in preparation for the next day's Stockades.
Received Atte's help with gear and crafting in Ironforge.
Met Atte in Stormwind and added spikes to his shield.
First met Atte and joined Furrassic Maul for the Stockade, Shadowfang Keep, Excavation Site: Wetlands, Wailing Caverns and Gnomeregan, defeating every boss together on 9 November.
